nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/de ma thob kyi bar du phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad rnams

tei:div.tei:p: nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de ma thob kyi bar du phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad rnams zhi zhing bsam pa'i don thams cad gegs med du 'grub pa dang*/ khyad par du tshe'i 'gal rkyen thams cad zhi ba dang*/ tshe'i dngos grub thob par bya/ de'i phyir du bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang bskur ba zab mo zhu snyam pa'i mos pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal/ de'i phyir du bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i dbang bskur ba zab mo zhu snyam pa'i mos pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal/ de lta bu'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang sgrub pa'i rten phun sum tshogs pa ni/ dal 'byor bco brgyad dang ldan pa'i mi lus rin po che 'di nyid yin la/ de ni shin tu rnyed par dka' zhing rnyed pa don chen po dang ldan pa yin te/ slob spring las/ bde gshegs lam rten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing*// sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa// lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang*// mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi 'am ci dang lto 'phyes min// mi yi dngos po shin tu rnyed dka' rnyed gyur nas// don du brtags pa gang yin de ni bstun te sgrubs// zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ de ltar thob pas mi chog spyir 'dzam bu gling pa rnams kyi tshe la nges pa med cing*/ khyad par snyigs ma'i mthar thug pas dus min du 'chi ba'i rkyen dang bar chad mang po dang ldan pa yin te/ sdud pa las/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir bar chad kyi rkyen mang zhing khyad par du dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i rkyen ni/ tshe dang las dang bsod nams zad pa ste rkyang zad gsum dang*/ de dag gnyis gnyis zad pa gsum las/ tshe zad pa la/ tshe sgrub kyi cho ga dang*/ las zad pa la/ srog bslu nye 'don sogs dang*/

bsod nams zad pa la mchod sbyin la sogs pas gso ba dang/ de dag gnyis gnyis mnyam du zad pa ni/ gnyen po de dang de'i gso ba gsungs pa las gso bya'i tshe nyid nyams pa'i rkyen/ nyams pa'i rtags/ gso byed slob dpon/ gso tshul dang bzhi ru las gsungs pa ste/ dam nyams sems 'khrugs yid chad dang ba dang*// zhe sdang drag po rbod gtong tshar bcad dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa dang*// gnas ngan dag tu gnas phabs 'di dag ni// tshe nyams 'gugs sngags dbugs sngangs bgegs kyi dbang du 'gyur// zhes dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khor la khro zhing sdug skad 'byin pa dang*// bzhin 'gyur spyod lam rnams ni 'chol ba dang*// slob dpon 'tsho byed dus las yol ba dang*/ kha zas rnams kyang yid khar mi 'ong bar// 'di dag rnams ni nyams pa'i rtags yin no// zhes dang*/ gsum pa ni/ ting 'dzin phra mo las su rung ba dang*// rgyud kyi don la mkhas shing dbang thob pa// mthu byin che zhing dam can nye ba gsum// 'di gsum gang gis bkug kyang khug par 'gyur// zhes dang*/ bzhi pa ni/ ji ltar gso ba'i cho ga ste/ lung bstan bka' rgya ma las/ lho phyogs 'od zer mi can sprul pa'i sku// zab don snying thig chos kyi 'gro ba 'dren// 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhing du 'phen pa 'byung*// zhes dang*/ gnad byang las/ bī ma rgyal sras lha rje sogs// thugs bskyed smon lam gcig bsdus pa// rang byung gdengs dang ldan pa yi// rtogs grol dus mnyam thugs gter bdag /gsang mtshan gar dbang 'jigs med gling*// zhes bī ma dang chos rgyal chen po zung gi rol gar rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling pa'i dgongs gter nam mkha' mdzod kyi chos sde las byon pa'i klong chen snying gi thig le'i nang sgrub rig 'dzin 'dus pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe sgrub bdud rtsi'i bum bcud kyi dbang bskur skabs su babs pa ste/ de nyid las/

thugs rje ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis// dad dam ldan pa'i slob ma la// gzhung bzhin 'dir ni sus bskur ba// 'chi bdag kha ru tshud kyang thon// byad du bcug kyang ya mi nga*// zhes pas/ rigs lnga'i dam tshig rig 'dzin la brten nas 'byung ba lnga'i khams gsum tshe nyams pa gso ba/ dha na saṃ kri la brten nas bla tshe nyams pa 'thor ba sdud pa/ bī ma mi tra la brten nas bla tshe zad pa phyir bsring ba/ rom bu ghu h+ya la brten nas lha 'dre mthu bo ches brkus pa'i bla tshe 'phrogs pa/ shin+taṃ ghar+bha la brten nas pha rol po'i byad du bcug pas bla tshe nyams pa gso ba/ rgyal mchog tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa'i go cha bgo ba ste/ tshe sgrub gzhan las khyad par gyi chos du mas 'phags pa'i bod yul sa 'og kun gyi gter gcig ma 'di lta bu'i dbang bskur zhu ba'i slad du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ ༈ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs/ bka' drin stsol/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo gnyis su med pa la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi skyabs yul ma tshang ba med pa'i spyan sngar skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed 'di'i rjes zlos/ na mo bdag dang mtha' yas sogs dang*/ ho rig 'dzin/ de nas yan lag brgyad ldan pa'i sgo nas rgyun phyag bya ba ni/ slob dpon tshe dpag med du gsal ba'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin bzhugs par bsam la 'di'i rjes zlos/ ho/ chu las chu bur sogs lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi gzhi bzung ba sdom pa dang dam tshig la rag las pas/ mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje drwa ba gur gyi rgyud las gsung pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ dkon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum/ de nas dbang gi ye shes pa dbab pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzod/

ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swā bha wa at+ma ko3 haṃ/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mi dmigs par stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid bde bar gshegs pa'i snying po hūm̐ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las gu ru snang srid zil gnon mdo sngags zung gi rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs pa'i spyi bor bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa yab yum gsal ba'i sbyor mtshams nas byang sems ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyi mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad tshe dpag med pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dngos grub thams cad sku dang yig 'bru phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byon nas khyed rang rnams la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐/ spros bral chos sku'i pho brang nas/ sogs/ de ltar ye shes pa'i lha tshogs byang chub bar du brtan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ tshe 'gugs pa'i slad du/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ltar phyogs bcur 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams kyi nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i tshe dang ye shes 'byung ba lnga'i dwangs bcud/ khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe chad nyams yar ba thams cad 'ja' zer thig le phyag mtshan gyi rnam par byon nas dbang po'i sgo ba spu'i bu ga nas thim zhing de thams cad bcud du dril nas tshe dpag med pa rdul phran gyi gong bu tsam du gyur pa'i zhal nas tshe yi snying po hrīḥyi rang sgra bung ba tshang zhig pa ltar di ri ri bzlas pas 'chi ba med pa tshe'i go 'phang thob par mos/ oṃ rang snang zangs mdog

sogs/ de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i slad du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ 'chi med mgon po sogs/ gzhung bzhin no/ de ltar bder 'dus tshe lung bdun pa las/ tshe bca' tshe yi dkyil 'khor dang*// tshe yi rang bzhin dgug pa dang*// tshe bcing tshe yi brlan thabs dang*// tshe yi dbang bskur bstim pa dang*// zhes pa bzhin legs par grub pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du bsngo ba dang smon pa'i thugs 'dun lhan cig tu gnang bar zhu/ ༈ 'o/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du gang zhig gsan par bya ba'i chos kyi rim pa/ 'o/ da lam sogs/ de ltar dbang bskur thob kyi dge bas mtshon rang gzhan rnams kyi rnam dkar kyi phung po rnams sems can thams cad bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob pa'i ched du bsngo ba dang smon pa'i rgyas 'debs gnang bar zhu/ bsod nams 'di yi thams cad sogs/ de ltar dbang don gyi ye shes ma skyes pa skyes/ skyes pa mi nyams pa brtan par gyur cig de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams dang 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs rnams kyis zhal nas bkra shis pa'i bden tshig gi glu dbyangs dar dir brjod cing me tog man+da ra ba'i char bab te 'phral yun kun tu dge zhing bkra shis pa'i mos pa mdzod cig bkra shis pa'i sho lo ka ci rigs brjod par bya'o// ༈ sangs rgyas phrin las 'dus pa myur dpa' mo// bar chad sel mdzad lha mo nyer gcig ma// gsol ba 'debs so byang chub sgrub pa yi// 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug zhi bar mdzod// ces so/// /
